title: The Tablet That Would Not Start
story: Jules needed the tablet for a video call with his cousin. He pressed the button, but the screen stayed black. A small light showed the battery was empty. He plugged in the cable and waited. Nothing changed. Jules checked the wall socket and tried a different cable from the drawer. The screen lit up at once. He smiled and turned the brightness down to save power. Before the call he closed extra apps. His cousin Maya appeared and waved. They talked about school and a film they both liked. Near the end the battery warning returned. Jules told Maya he would call again after a full charge.
